build_quantize_model_scalar: build a python module to quantize a model using scalar quantization noise from a DictConfig
create_Quantizer_class: create a Quantizer instance that parses a YAML config and schedules iterative product quantization
test_Quantizer_step: test the Quantizer step method to move to the next stage of layer quantization
review_Quantizer_begin_epoch: review the Quantizer begin_epoch method to trigger quantization at scheduled epoch intervals
summarize_Quantizer_state_dict: summarize the Quantizer state_dict and load_state_dict methods for saving and restoring quantization state
